import gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
from collections import Counter
from fractions import Fraction
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
expected_head="a0cf721c0a3fd5bc034e010119d2b09d148de8ec"
expected_tree="0fee4598d69db92beea2845c6d939f059f2d14a3"
def digest(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def read_json(name,expected=None):
    raw=(root/name).read_bytes()
    if expected is not None: assert digest(raw)==expected,(name,"sha256")
    return json.loads(raw),raw
report,report_raw=read_json("paired/report.json","2e70fd95fe3fb9763d311241fe979089ff5644a23b77859413705b09a3c77efc")
manifest,manifest_raw=read_json("execution-manifest.json","63e96b22d1329515e423cf701c2b421bff7da2e4ce41f8973780fe80f9a979fc")
before,before_raw=read_json("source-before.json","bbf4c3be432d3440eff4ee91c279c9e134d2bc1b0d4e16521926f5b12490f9bb")
after,after_raw=read_json("source-after.json","bbf4c3be432d3440eff4ee91c279c9e134d2bc1b0d4e16521926f5b12490f9bb")
assert before_raw==after_raw
assert before["tested_commit"]==expected_head and before["tested_tree"]==expected_tree
assert report["source"]==report["source_after"]
assert report["source"]["git_head"]==expected_head and report["source"]["tree"]==expected_tree
assert len(report["observations"])==72 and len(report["paired_comparisons"])==36
result=[]
seen_files=set()
all_blocks=0
all_rows=0
for observation in report["observations"]:
    name=observation["trace_file"]
    assert name not in seen_files and pathlib.PurePath(name).name==name
    seen_files.add(name)
    raw=(root/"paired"/name).read_bytes()
    expected=manifest["files"]["paired/"+name]
    assert len(raw)==expected["bytes"] and digest(raw)==expected["sha256"],(name,"trace digest")
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in gzip.decompress(raw).splitlines() if line.strip()]
    summary=observation["summary"]
    assert len(rows)==summary["trace_rows"] and not summary["trace_limit_reached"],(name,"trace row count")
    assert summary["termination"]=="horizon" and summary["observation_seconds"]==600
    assert [r["row"] for r in rows]==list(range(len(rows))),(name,"row order")
    block_rows=[r for r in rows if r["kind"]=="block"]
    blocks={r["block"]:r for r in block_rows}
    assert len(blocks)==len(block_rows),(name,"duplicate block")
    prefix_work=None
    prefix_height=None
    for b in block_rows:
        work=int(b["required_work"])
        chainwork=int(b["chainwork"])
        target=int(b["target_hex"],16)
        assert work==(1<<256)//(target+1) and work>0,(name,b["block"],"work formula")
        if b["parent"]=="prefix":
            base_work=chainwork-work
            base_height=b["height"]-1
            if prefix_work is None: prefix_work,prefix_height=base_work,base_height
            assert (base_work,base_height)==(prefix_work,prefix_height),(name,"inconsistent prefix")
        else:
            parent=blocks[b["parent"]]
            assert parent["row"]<b["row"],(name,"parent not yet created")
            assert chainwork==int(parent["chainwork"])+work,(name,b["block"],"chainwork recursion")
            assert b["height"]==parent["height"]+1,(name,b["block"],"height recursion")
    assert prefix_work is not None
    observer=[r for r in rows if r["kind"]=="adopt" and r["recipient"]=="observer"]
    assert observer and observer[-1]["tip"]==summary["observer_tip"],(name,"observer final tip")
    for adoption in observer:
        assert int(adoption["chainwork"])==int(blocks[adoption["tip"]]["chainwork"]),(name,"adopt chainwork")
    tip=summary["observer_tip"]
    lineage=[]
    visited=set()
    while tip!="prefix":
        assert tip not in visited,(name,"ancestry cycle")
        visited.add(tip)
        block=blocks[tip]
        lineage.append(block)
        tip=block["parent"]
    lineage.reverse()
    credits={m:sum(int(b["required_work"]) for b in lineage if b["miner"]==m) for m in ("q","c0","c1")}
    counts=Counter(b["miner"] for b in lineage)
    total=sum(int(b["required_work"]) for b in lineage)
    assert set(counts)<=set(credits)
    assert sum(credits.values())==total
    assert len(lineage)==summary["observer_added_blocks"],(name,"observer added block count")
    assert total==int(summary["observer_added_chainwork"]),(name,"observer added chainwork")
    assert int(blocks[summary["observer_tip"]]["chainwork"])==prefix_work+total,(name,"final chainwork")
    assert counts["q"]==observation["metrics"]["quantum_blocks_on_observer_chain"],(name,"q adopted count")
    created=Counter(b["miner"] for b in block_rows)
    for miner in ("q","c0","c1"):
        assert created[miner]==summary["miners"][miner]["blocks_created"],(name,miner,"created count")
    qblocks=[{"block":b["block"],"parent":b["parent"],"height":b["height"],"timestamp":b["timestamp"],"at_seconds":b["at_seconds"],"row":b["row"],"target_hex":b["target_hex"],"required_work":str(b["required_work"])} for b in lineage if b["miner"]=="q"]
    result.append({"pair_id":observation["pair_id"],"policy":observation["policy"],"trace_file":name,"trace_sha256":digest(raw),"trace_rows":len(rows),"created_blocks":len(block_rows),"observer_tip":summary["observer_tip"],"prefix_chainwork":str(prefix_work),"prefix_height":prefix_height,"observer_added_blocks":len(lineage),"observer_added_chainwork":str(total),"credited_work_by_miner":{k:str(v) for k,v in credits.items()},"adopted_block_counts_by_miner":{k:counts[k] for k in credits},"q_credit_share":str(Fraction(credits["q"],total)),"accepted_q_blocks":qblocks})
    all_blocks+=len(block_rows)
    all_rows+=len(rows)
print(json.dumps({"status":"FROZEN_TRACE_WEIGHTED_CREDIT_RECONSTRUCTION_PASS","head":expected_head,"tree":expected_tree,"report_sha256":digest(report_raw),"execution_manifest_sha256":digest(manifest_raw),"trace_files_checked":len(seen_files),"trace_rows_checked":all_rows,"created_block_work_and_parent_checks":all_blocks,"observations":result},sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")))
